test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

The talk was not __understandable __.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"The talk was not understandable"** is grammatically correct.
 
• The word **"understandable"** is appropriately used in this context to mean something that can be understood.
 
• There is no need to substitute the underlined word, as the original sentence conveys the intended meaning.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The talk was not **understandable .'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2:** "Comprehensible"** also means capable of being understood but is not required as a substitution here.
 
• Option 3:** "Comprehended"** means understood, but it is not suitable for the sentence.
 
• Option 4: **"Comprehensive"** means thorough and complete in detail, which does not fit in this context.
